name: session-board
description: Kanban board of Claude Code sessions in the desktop app, VS Code and the terminal: running, needs me, finished, idle

autoOpen.description: Open the session board when a session starts, so it is already there when you switch sessions
autoOpen.title: Open the board at session start

modelJudge.title: Let a model spot requests with no question mark
modelJudge.description: Sends the end of each finished reply that has no question to a small model, once, to decide whether it waits for you. Uses a little of your quota. Off by default

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the board re-reads sessions; also the longest lag before another session's filing shows here (1–60)
